entries.title: Ezekiel 5:1
segments: ¶And thou, son of man, take thee a sharp knife, take thee a barber's razor, and cause [it] to pass upon thine head and upon thy beard: then take thee balances to weigh, and divide the [hair].

entries.title: Ezekiel 5:2
segments: Thou shalt burn with fire a third part in the midst of the city, when the days of the siege are fulfilled: and thou shalt take a third part, [and] smite about it with a knife: and a third part thou shalt scatter in the wind; and I will draw out a sword after them.

entries.title: Ezekiel 5:3
segments: Thou shalt also take thereof a few in number, and bind them in thy skirts. {skirts: Heb. wings}

entries.title: Ezekiel 5:4
segments: Then take of them again, and cast them into the midst of the fire, and burn them in the fire; [for] thereof shall a fire come forth into all the house of Israel.

entries.title: Ezekiel 5:5
segments: ¶Thus saith the Lord GOD; This [is] Jerusalem: I have set it in the midst of the nations and countries [that are] round about her.

entries.title: Ezekiel 5:6
segments: And she hath changed my judgments into wickedness more than the nations, and my statutes more than the countries that [are] round about her: for they have refused my judgments and my statutes, they have not walked in them.

entries.title: Ezekiel 5:7
segments: Therefore thus saith the Lord GOD; Because ye multiplied more than the nations that [are] round about you, [and] have not walked in my statutes, neither have kept my judgments, neither have done according to the judgments of the nations that [are] round about you;

entries.title: Ezekiel 5:8
segments: Therefore thus saith the Lord GOD; Behold, I, even I, [am] against thee, and will execute judgments in the midst of thee in the sight of the nations.

words.text: ; Behold, I, even I, [am] against thee, and will execute

entries.title: Ezekiel 5:9
segments: And I will do in thee that which I have not done, and whereunto I will not do any more the like, because of all thine abominations.

words.text: in thee that which I have not done
, and whereunto I will not do

entries.title: Ezekiel 5:10
segments: Therefore the fathers shall eat the sons in the midst of thee, and the sons shall eat their fathers; and I will execute judgments in thee, and the whole remnant of thee will I scatter into all the winds.

words.text: in thee, and the whole remnant

entries.title: Ezekiel 5:11
segments: Wherefore, [as] I live, saith the Lord GOD; Surely, because thou hast defiled my sanctuary with all thy detestable things, and with all thine abominations, therefore will I also diminish [thee]; neither shall mine eye spare, neither will I have any pity.

words.text: , neither will I have any pity

entries.title: Ezekiel 5:12
segments: A third part of thee shall die with the pestilence, and with famine shall they be consumed in the midst of thee: and a third part shall fall by the sword round about thee; and I will scatter a third part into all the winds, and I will draw out a sword after them.

words.text: of thee: and a third part

entries.title: Ezekiel 5:13
segments: Thus shall mine anger be accomplished, and I will cause my fury to rest upon them, and I will be comforted: and they shall know that I the LORD have spoken [it] in my zeal, when I have accomplished my fury in them.

words.text: , and I will cause my fury
upon them, and I will be comforted

entries.title: Ezekiel 5:14
segments: Moreover I will make thee waste, and a reproach among the nations that [are] round about thee, in the sight of all that pass by.

entries.title: Ezekiel 5:15
segments: So it shall be a reproach and a taunt, an instruction and an astonishment unto the nations that [are] round about thee, when I shall execute judgments in thee in anger and in fury and in furious rebukes. I the LORD have spoken [it].

words.text: So it shall be a reproach

entries.title: Ezekiel 5:16
segments: When I shall send upon them the evil arrows of famine, which shall be for [their] destruction, [and] which I will send to destroy you: and I will increase the famine upon you, and will break your staff of bread:

entries.title: Ezekiel 5:17
segments: So will I send upon you famine and evil beasts, and they shall bereave thee; and pestilence and blood shall pass through thee; and I will bring the sword upon thee. I the LORD have spoken [it].
